jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As part of the Siemens Energy Global Sales organization, you will develop new business opportunities for competitive and innovative surge arrester applications. You will expand our market presence, identify potential customers, and initiate homologation processes for international markets.You will promote our solutions and technical expertise, evaluate market potential and customer needs, support go-to-market strategies, and oversee order intake. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure technical and commercial accuracy throughout the bidding and order process. You will lead customer consultations and tailor our offerings to specific market requirements, creating a strong foundation for successful business execution.How You’ll Make an Impact * Development of tailored technical solutions based on customer specifications in close collaboration with technical departments* Coordination of international technical clarifications and support requests as the primary point of contact* Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Engineering, R&D, Factory Planning, and Quality Management to ensure continuous customer satisfaction* Customer and partner engagement, including contract negotiations, presentations, training sessions, qualification processes, and FATs* Identification and development of new customers, expansion of market penetration, and management of homologation processes for successful market entry* Development and implementation of growth and market strategies, including the identification of innovative solutions and continuous improvement of effectivenessWhat You Bring* Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, combined with a strong technical understanding of high-voltage products* Professional experience in Technical Sales, R&D, or PLM within the energy industry* Goal-oriented and proactive team mindset with a strong commitment to continuous improvement* Excellent communication and presentation skills across all organizational levels* Fluency in English, with German and additional language skills considered an advantage* Strong analytical and organizational skills, proficiency in MS Office and SAP, and willingness to travel internationally About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
